name: com.pragma.dots
description: Building blocks for multiplayer games on Unity DOTS: fixed-point math, actors (game objects described in assets of parts, spawned by key, placed on maps, baked or built at run time) and utilities, with opt-in modules. Lockstep: deterministic lockstep with an isolated simulation world, a server that orders inputs, adaptive input timing, desync detection with state hashes, late join, replays, an offline mode that runs the same code path and a Netcode for Entities transport. Navigation, vision, stats and pooled GameObject views build on it.
